mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Ordered composition of normalized Markov kernels along a finite scale-indexed partial order, with the likelihood at scale 0 only.
mechanism_families.representation: Measure-level tower on a fixed product of standard Borel spaces with finite label pools.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Normalization without a partition function; the obstruction is any factor whose codomain depends on a realized earlier value.
obligations: Prove normalization and the conditional-KL decomposition.
mechanism_families.bridge: Conditional relative-entropy chain rule at the measure level.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A factor with a value-dependent measurable codomain.
open_gaps: Necessity of the observation integrability condition.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: ordered kernel tower + label pools + two-channel memberships + holonomy marks as generated variables

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Exhibit an admissible tower whose observation marginal is partition-independent, forcing the minimized free energy to be constant across partitions.
mechanism_families.representation: Copy parent space with Dirac downward kernel.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: The minimized free energy depends on the partition only through the observation marginal.
mechanism_families.bridge: Minimum of the free energy equals minus log evidence.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A typing hypothesis excluding the copy construction.
open_gaps: Whether some capacity bound restores selection and persistence.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: copy-parent witness + block-factorization compatibility + posterior-equals-prior corollary

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Treat the joint directed edge-event law as the primitive gauge-invariant object: push it, disintegrate it, and build a directed Laplacian from it.
mechanism_families.representation: Probability law on ordered node pairs plus normalized endpoint kernels.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Additivity under blocking; rows are not additive.
obligations: Supply intrinsic scales that are genuine metrics.
mechanism_families.bridge: Perron occupancy identifies the symmetrization with Chung's directed Laplacian.
mechanism_families.failure_test: Occupancy not preserved by symmetrization under a stationary receiver law.
open_gaps: No rescaling kernel, hence no renormalization semigroup.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: edge-event law + Perron occupancy + Chung symmetrization + effective-resistance metric + two-channel scale spectra

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Retain the conditional law of dressed transports rather than a barycenter, and read blindness as a support condition on the stabilizer.
mechanism_families.representation: Markov kernel from the coarse state into probability measures on the structure group.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: Empty intersection of the holonomy fixed set with the admitted family forces infinite distortion.
mechanism_families.bridge: Pushforward of the joint edge-event-and-mark law.
mechanism_families.failure_test: An equivariant admitted family always containing a fixed point.
open_gaps: Conditional independence of consecutive dressed marks.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: dressed transport law + convolution under conditional independence + stabilizer support criterion

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Use LaSalle on one scalar with symmetric mobility to bound what cross-scale feedback can produce.
mechanism_families.representation: Natural-gradient flow on the tower recognition parameters.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: A single scalar plus symmetric mobility forbids a nonequilibrium steady state.
mechanism_families.bridge: Enumeration of the four ways to break the hypotheses.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A nonconstant omega-limit set under the stated hypotheses.
open_gaps: Projected flows on simplex boundaries; indefinite mobilities.
mechanism_families.novelty_fingerprint: LaSalle bar + four-mechanism enumeration + non-integrability as the technical content of participatory feedback

mechanism_families.core_mechanism: Show that a deterministic pushforward and an independent same-time cause cannot coexist, by disintegration, overdetermination, Fubini nullity, and absence of a topological ordering.
mechanism_families.representation: Joint law on a child-parent pair with a Borel coarse map.
mechanism_families.invariant_or_obstruction: A directed 2-cycle has no normalized ordered composition.
mechanism_families.failure_test: A normalized joint realizing both arrows nondegenerately.
open_gaps: Finite normalizer for the soft reciprocal model.
